rooms.name: Operating Theatre 1
rooms.notes: Primary general OT; laminar-flow HVAC zone; positive pressure; sterile zone boundary at scrub bay

rooms.name: Operating Theatre 2
rooms.notes: Secondary / specialty OT (e.g. ortho/gynaec); shared scrub bay with OT-1; sterile zone

rooms.name: Scrub Bay / Pre-Op Preparation
rooms.notes: Shared scrub sink zone between the two OTs; stainless steel trough sinks; tiled splash zone

rooms.name: Intensive Care Unit (ICU)
rooms.notes: 6-bed open ICU at 8 sqm per bed (IPHS norm); central monitoring station; negative-pressure-capable HVAC

rooms.name: Recovery / Post-Op Room
rooms.notes: 4-bed post-anaesthesia recovery unit; wheeled-stretcher clearance 1.2 m each side; piped O2 & suction

rooms.name: Pre-Op Consultation Room
rooms.notes: Anaesthesiology / surgical pre-op assessment; privacy required; natural light preferred

rooms.name: Surgical Consultation Room
rooms.notes: General surgical / specialist review room adjacent to waiting area

rooms.name: Nurses' Station
rooms.notes: Central nursing control for ICU and recovery; unobstructed sightlines to both units; medication storage alcove

rooms.name: Sterile Supplies Store
rooms.notes: CSSD pass-through cupboards; temperature-controlled; no external windows; HEPA-filtered air supply

rooms.name: Medical Equipment Store
rooms.notes: Anaesthesia machines, ventilators, portable monitors; wide door (min 1.5 m) for equipment movement

rooms.name: Staff Pantry
rooms.notes: For OT/ICU clinical staff; hot beverages and light snacks; not accessible to patients/visitors

rooms.name: Relatives Waiting Lounge
rooms.notes: Segregated from clinical zones; natural light from external wall; seating for ~20 persons

rooms.name: Main Clinical Corridor
rooms.notes: Min 2.4 m clear width (NBC Group C hospital corridor); stretcher-accessible; separate clean and dirty sub-corridors where possible

rooms.name: Staff / Clinical Toilet Block (Male)
rooms.notes: For clinical staff; 2 WC + 1 urinal + wash basins; accessible compliant; NBC Group C

rooms.name: Staff / Clinical Toilet Block (Female)
rooms.notes: For clinical staff; 2 WC + wash basins; accessible compliant; placed away from OT sterile zone

rooms.name: Relatives / Visitor Toilet
rooms.notes: Adjacent to relatives waiting lounge; NBC accessible toilet; segregated from clinical staff toilets

response.floor_summary: Floor 2 is the surgical and critical-care floor, housing two Operating Theatres with a shared scrub bay, a 6-bed ICU, a post-operative recovery room, pre-op consultation rooms, a central nurses' station, sterile and equipment stores, a relatives waiting lounge, staff pantry, and segregated toilet blocks — all arranged around a wide NBC-compliant clinical corridor.
